overview: From 2026-11-05 to 2026-11-06, ethereum-optimism/specs had 2 new PRs (4 merged), 0 new issues, and 4 active contributors.

topPRs.title: zk: align ZK dispute game specs with the implementation
topPRs.author: wwared
topPRs.body:
Brings the ZK dispute game specs in line with the monorepo implementation: fixes outdated contract details (game type, `SuperRootProof` encoding, verifier, OPCM config and validation, game mechanics), adds the public interface reference, rewrites migration around `upgrade()`/`migrate()`, documents the SP1 program structure and proof completeness, and adds an honest actors page. The ZK Fault Proof VM page is renamed to ZK Proof System (with a redirect), and the dispute game interface, portal and OPCM migrator pages get matching fixes.

Closes ethereum-optimism/proofs-team#9. Commits are self-contained and can be reviewed one by one.

topPRs.title: interop: Address review findings on message expiry
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
Stacked on ethereum-optimism/specs#960. This change fixes the findings from a review of the message expiry specs.

Correctness:
- A message to a chain whose portal the source chain's `ETHLockbox` does not authorize can expire after the `ETHLockbox` authorizes it. The text no longer says such a message can never expire.
- A caller that shares the `ETHLockbox` is paused with the source chain, so a pause revert of `relayUndeliveredMessage` is not recorded as a failed message.
- `ETHLockbox` authorization is permanent. A chain whose portal moves to another lockbox can still attest. The aME-001 mitigation no longer claims a shared custody of ETH.

Structure:
- The `EXPIRY_PERIOD >= EXPIRY_WINDOW` rule is now stated once, as aME-002. The contract cannot enforce it.
- Process and tooling text is removed. The dependency set condition is now assumption aME-004.
- The new iME-006 holds the emit-once and record-every-relay rules from the safety argument.
- iEL-005 moves to the `L1CrossDomainMessenger` spec as invariant i01-006, because that contract owns the nonce. iEL-004 now depends on it. The iSEB-004 dependencies are corrected.
- The L1 unsafe targets text links to the existing `relayMessage` spec.
- "Expiring Messages" moves under "Interfaces", so that it no longer nests "Relaying Messages".

There are also smaller wording fixes.

topPRs.title: interop: Give SuperchainETHBridge event headings unique anchors
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
Stacked on ethereum-optimism/specs#960.

The `SendETH`, `RelayETH` and `RefundETH` event headings differ from the `sendETH`, `relayETH` and `refundETH` function headings only in case. doctoc treats them as different headings and gives both the same anchor. mdBook and GitHub lowercase heading ids, so they add a `-1` suffix to the event headings. As a result, the table of contents links each event to its function.

This change adds "event" to each event heading, so that each heading has a unique anchor. No links in the body point to the event headings.
